verdict.rationale: Stripe documents stablecoin Financial Accounts that let businesses hold, receive, and send stablecoin balances alongside fiat Treasury, plus card issuance backed by those balances, but there is no explicit documentation of a finance-lead-facing internal transfer/rebalancing flow moving value between fiat and stablecoin balances via API or dashboard — the onramp/payout docs are customer- or payout-facing, not treasury rebalancing tools. missing for 10: dedicated API/dashboard endpoint or flow for converting/rebalancing between fiat and stablecoin balances, end-to-end docs for finance-lead treasury operations, independent confirmation of this workflow.
